glosses: date (day on which a certain event takes place)
deadline (date on or before which something must be completed)
delivery date (day on which something is scheduled to arrive at the delivery address)

examples.text: Ich habe einen Termin beim Arzt.

examples.en: Do you have any appointments tomorrow?

examples.text: Haben Sie bei ihm einen Termin?
examples.en: Do you have an appointment with him?

examples.text: Sagen Sie alle meine Termine ab.
